quests.title: Seafoam Islands: the ice walls, Articuno and the researcher (TM14 Blizzard)
Seafoam Islands: Team Rocket and Kyogre (League HQ investigation), and catching Kyogre

acquisitions.conditions: After the final Hall of Fame entry and Lance’s visit to your home in Pallet Town. Melt the Seafoam Islands ice barriers to reach Articuno. Earlier trainer-style battles cannot catch it. One encounter; catching, defeating or fleeing removes it.
